title: Restricted Fourier weight estimator program
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, let $S\subseteq J$, and let $m\in\mathbb N$. The membership-query program draws three batches of $m$ uniform sign vectors, then, position by position, uses the first batch's coordinates outside $J$ and the second and third batches' coordinates on $J$ to form two inputs and queries the target at both. It records the rational restricted Fourier weight observations, charges $2n+2|S|+1$ local steps per position and a further $m+1$ steps, and returns their sum divided by $m$.
